title: On to What’s Next . . .
coreMove: Stillness lasts when you train the next default first: arrange sleep, space, movement, and limits so the body helps the soul keep its promises under pressure.

exampleSpecs.stakes: notice the bodily contradiction before the lesson turns hollow
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist notices his own error while teaching Epictetus as training

exampleSpecs.audience: groups whose good intentions keep losing to loose routines
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn belief into a written order before the week repeats
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a memo uses monastic daily order to change the house schedule

exampleSpecs.audience: professionals who think intentions alone decide the next morning
exampleSpecs.stakes: show how one hour after work can train the next day
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two people meet the same tired evening with opposite bodily defaults

exampleSpecs.audience: helpers frustrated that small routines feel beneath spiritual aims
exampleSpecs.stakes: make the reframe quotable and small enough to do
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a peer reframes bodily routine as the place vows tell the truth

exampleSpecs.audience: learners who hear rule as loss of freedom
exampleSpecs.stakes: use confusion to reveal the hidden order already running the morning

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders whose morning environment defeats their stated values
